reproduction_validator_source:
import json
import pathlib
import sqlite3
import sys

repo=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]); scratch=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2])
sys.path[:0]=[str(repo/'src'),str(repo/'docs/implementation/evidence/adr0031-i2-preparation')]
from repo_catalog.adapters.sqlite import p1_schema
from resource_udfs import register
db=sqlite3.connect(':memory:',isolation_level=None)
p1_schema.register_functions(db);register(db)
db.executescript('PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON; PRAGMA recursive_triggers=ON; PRAGMA ignore_check_constraints=OFF; PRAGMA trusted_schema=ON;')
db.executescript((scratch/'final-run/3510300/after.sql').read_text())
def rows():
    return {n:db.execute('SELECT * FROM "'+n+'"').fetchall()
            for n, in db.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_schema WHERE type='table' ORDER BY name")}
pending='';errors=[]
for line in (repo/'docs/implementation/evidence/adr0031-i2-f1-task-f/counterexamples.sql').read_text().splitlines(keepends=True):
    pending+=line
    if sqlite3.complete_statement(pending):
        pre=rows()
        try:db.execute(pending).fetchall()
        except sqlite3.Error as e:
            assert e.sqlite_errorcode==1811 and pre==rows()
            errors.append({'sql':pending,'extended_code':e.sqlite_errorcode,'before':pre,'after':rows()})
        pending=''
assert not pending.strip() and len(errors)==5
assert all(not r for r in rows().values())
print(json.dumps({'version':db.execute('SELECT sqlite_version()').fetchone()[0],
                  'source_id':db.execute('SELECT sqlite_source_id()').fetchone()[0],
                  'expected_refusals':errors,'final_all_tables_empty':True},indent=2))
